scripts.dev: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:log: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name dev -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.dev:desktop:shell: node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 3000 && node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs --port 5173 && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop dev
scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/check-deps.cjs && node scripts/run-with-log.cjs --name desktop-dev -- pnpm dev:desktop:raw
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client build
scripts.build:desktop:all: corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server prisma:generate && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client build:desktop && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop build
scripts.stage:desktop:win: corepack pnpm run build:desktop:all && node desktop/scripts/stage-desktop.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify
scripts.stage:desktop:mac: corepack pnpm run build:desktop:all && node desktop/scripts/stage-desktop.cjs --platform mac --arch arm64 --mode verify
scripts.dist:desktop:nsis: corepack pnpm run stage:desktop:win && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target nsis
scripts.dist:desktop:nsis:reuse-stage: node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target nsis
scripts.dist:desktop: corepack pnpm run stage:desktop:win && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target all
scripts.dist:desktop:reuse-stage: node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target all
scripts.dist:desktop:portable: corepack pnpm run stage:desktop:win && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target portable
scripts.dist:desktop:portable:reuse-stage: node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target portable
scripts.dist:desktop:mac: corepack pnpm run stage:desktop:mac && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform mac --arch arm64 --mode verify --target all
scripts.dist:desktop:mac:reuse-stage: node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform mac --arch arm64 --mode verify --target all
scripts.test:desktop-packaging: corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop build && node --test desktop/scripts/*.test.cjs scripts/bump-desktop-version.test.cjs scripts/trigger-desktop-release.test.cjs scripts/update-desktop-release-notes.test.cjs
scripts.verify:desktop-package: corepack pnpm run stage:desktop:win && node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target dir && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-package.cjs
scripts.verify:desktop-package:reuse-stage: node desktop/scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --platform win --arch x64 --mode verify --target dir && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-package.cjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @ai-novel/desktop typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ai-novel/shared lint && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/server lint && pnpm --filter @ai-novel/client lint
